topic: Ideb avança em todas as etapas da educação básica Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: Ideb improved in all levels of basic education in Brazil, with the highest scores in the years of elementary school.
The teaching of middle school showed progress but did not meet the established goals.
The results of Ideb were impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic, affecting learning trajectories.
24 UFs had higher indices in the final years of elementary education, while 23 UFs improved in high school.
The Ministry of Education is focusing on creating 3.2 million new full-time school places to enhance learning.

stats.context: new full-time school places being created

quotes.text: Índice de Desenvolvimento da Educação Básica (Ideb) alcançou os maiores valores da série histórica em todas as etapas avaliadas.
O Brasil só superou a meta nos anos iniciais do ensino fundamental.

summary: The Ideb index has shown overall improvement across all levels of basic education in Brazil, particularly in elementary school. However, middle school results fell short of goals, and the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic has been significant on educational outcomes.

signal.title: Ideb avança em todas as etapas da educação básica
